notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Chromatic Star by paying {1}, tapping, and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Chromatic Star triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Chromatic Star from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Chromatic Star from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.
